name: Elvensang
source:
Elvensang is a story about a young elf raised alone by his mother in a human world that regards elves with scorn and hostility. The setting is inspired by the early medieval period with low fantasy elements. It is a ruthless, everchanging place that constantly puts one’s morality to the test, and it will be up to you to decide whether the story plays out as a tender romantic drama or a descent into the depths of malice and depravity.
​
translation:
《Elvensang》讲述了一个年轻的精灵在一个对精灵充满蔑视和敌意的人类世界中由母亲独自抚养长大的故事。设定灵感来自中世纪早期，奇幻元素较少。这是一个无情、瞬息万变的地方，不断考验一个人的道德，而故事是以温柔的浪漫戏剧展开，还是陷入恶意和堕落的深渊，将由你来决定。
​
